items.t: Constellation Energy Soars 13% in a Week on a Guidance Raise: “A Platform Heretofore Unseen”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy is up 13% in the past week after a third-quarter beat and its second guidance raise this year. After Vistra’s record quarter, Constellation’s report showed customers are still signing deals despite the midterm scare.

items.t: Constellation Energy Lands $5 Billion DOE Loan As Nuclear Uprates Accelerate
items.sum: The Department of Energy offered Constellation Energy a conditional loan commitment of up to $5 billion to finance power uprates across 8 reactors in multiple states.
